human_outcome_definitions.denominator_definition: Eligible responding people at a fixed time point

human_outcome_definitions.title: Reports with an error
human_outcome_definitions.required_definition: At least one independently adjudicated error per eligible report
human_outcome_definitions.denominator_definition: All eligible reports, including failed runs

human_outcome_definitions.title: Reports with a serious error
human_outcome_definitions.required_definition: At least one error meeting predefined severity criterion
human_outcome_definitions.denominator_definition: All eligible reports, including failed runs

human_outcome_definitions.title: People with a near miss
human_outcome_definitions.required_definition: At least one adjudicated event during a specified complete follow-up

human_outcome_definitions.title: People injured
human_outcome_definitions.required_definition: Predefined injury endpoint, complete identical follow-up

human_outcome_definitions.title: Fatality
human_outcome_definitions.required_definition: Death within a specified complete follow-up horizon; valid ascertainment

human_outcome_claim_policy.arithmetic_implemented: descriptive changes; Wilson under asserted independence; zero-event bound; paired score points
